note: TVA campground on a Norris Lake peninsula run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee, with a swimming beach and three cabins; 59 of its 64-65 sites have electric, and the outer ring of sites lines the shore. Only 27 RV sites book online (7 sold as waterfront); long-term sites take some of the rest. The interior roads are paved, but a reviewer found the approach road tight. --Claude
